newsitem.title: INDIA: ADB picks up stake in SBI subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: ADB picks up stake in SBI subsidiaries.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has signed agreements with the State Bank of India (SBI) to pick up equity stakes in SBI's investment subsidiaries, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Wednesday.
PTI said the ADB will invest 715 million rupees ($20 million) in SBI Capital Markets Ltd and 150 million rupees in SBI Gilts Limited (SBIGL).
This would give ADB a stake of about 14 percent in SBI Capital and 15 percent in SBIGL, the news agency reported.
The ADB will also pick up a stake of 24 per cent State Bank of India Securities Limited (SBISL) with an investment of 145 million rupees.
"The Banks association with ADB would add to the prestige and stature of the SBI group," PTI quoted SBI chairman P. G. Kakodkar as saying.
